verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents screening customers against sanctions, watchlists, PEPs and adverse media in a single global database. It does this through one API with synchronous, asynchronous and batch screening, with hits surfaced via webhook. It also provides one case-management surface, in the web app or via API, for reviewing and deciding alerts. However, nothing in the evidence shows it performs the identity verification itself, so screening 'as part of the same verification' with one vendor would need a separate IDV provider. Missing for 10: native identity verification bundled with screening in a single flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of screening quality.
